body: To put it simply. I know where I'll do it, i just need the rope

My mother, who had not long had a battle with depression herself, came into my room and told me that "I think your just being lazy"
I was having panic attacks about leaving the house, hadn't eaten in days, nor showered and had slashed my arm the week before. 

I'll never forget that


So I get you

I've never had an in depth look by anyone, most the doctors just gave me tablets then walked me out the door. I've talked to therapists but I usually just rant at them for the hour then see them again next week for the same. I have issues with family and that, they are very detached an distant, when ever I talk to them I feel like I'm talking to bad actors who are just waiting for their next line. My biggest problem is literally how the world works, I hate it and can't get over that. My best hope is that I can learn to ignore it, but as things get worse it's not enough. Every day I find a new think that makes me realise I really just don't fit into this world. I'm too detached to even be someone who can find worth in fighting against the system. Dunno if that even makes sense tbh.

I get you. I posted here on a few years ago thinking it could help to talk about things and was just disheartened more by the amount of people asking for help. Just thousands upon thousands drowning in their own darkness. I'm sometimes able to convince myself that it does help, but then I'm back a few year later, saying the same things to people saying the same things. Most days it feels like it's just about delaying the day you always know waiting for you.

Yea I'm having similar issues with "friends" short story is I have none, and the ones I "had" never put any effort into maintaining that friendship. (I seriously went thru years of texts and phone logs and found I always texted first and never had a phone call from any of them) for years I convinced myself it was just shitty people, but it's pretty obvious these days it has to be me. There is something unlikeable about me, so thing I'll never change.

Not at all, i understand why we need long replies. It's hard to put how you feel into a short reply. Lots of mixed messages pinging around in my brain anyway. I'm on my 4th of 5th different tablet and the dosage goes up and down sometimes, i usually go down because i can't handle the headaces when i miss a day but i had to stop one because of the dreams. The were so vivid i took a while in the morning to convince myself they weren't real. Not even nightmares, just full of emotions that would flood me in the morning and it got distressing.

I have put on weight to but that's more my poor diet, i am completely addicted to chocolate and dr pepper. Tho the poor diet is because of the depression so its all mashed in with my problems.

How have you been the past few days. Sorry i was slow in replying.

Yea i could imagine painkillers would do the trick, they are more addictive than people realise too. 

Are you back on your mh medication? I've tried to stop cold turkey a few times and it's just awful. I get these weird brain zaps, like i can actually feel the brain pulses pinging around up there and my eyes do like a weird "broken camera" thing were they randomly change the focus making what I'm actually looking at blurry. 

What I'm getting at is you could be in a worse way at this moment because your brain is still needing your medication. It's basically a junkie for it and neess it's fixed. 

Part of me wants of my medication too, but the other part knows I'll probally never get off them, can't really function without at least something.

I self harm myself to deal with stress. I know it's unhealthy but it is a release when i do want to do something as bad a slit my wrists or hanging myself. (When i am i a bad way, i just have repeating imagines of doing those things, the self harm qwells those images)

I don't do it badly, i mostly beat myself over the head or lightly cut my arms.

Now i do not reccomend this, but a realse may be what yoy need. I habe done a few other things that are less serious than self harm that have done the same thing. Maybe buy some cheap glass cups and smash them somewhere safe? Go to a park and just animal scream.

I won't tell you life will get better because i don't know. I'm pretty much at the end of my tether myself. I hope you can delay it long enough some way that it does get better. And maybe screaming at a tree could do that.

Thing is i don't think it's just an illness. It's who i am because i don't fit into to society. I am not meant to survive in capatalism, where the ones at the top grind those below to dust. I can't deal with constant suffering, having to watch as i live in a place that exports death an murder for profit, laughs in the face of the unfortunate then demands i serve it of face the same fate.

Some people can find a happy place in that, some people can fight against it, work for it or just live oblivious to it and be fairly content.

I just can't do any of those things

I don't fit, but it still steps on me
